svg.title: Azure SRE Agent - AKS demo infrastructure
svg.desc: Infrastructure defined by the demo templates: AKS, ACR and workload monitoring in the workload resource group; virtual network, node subnet, Node Pool and Load Balancer in the AKS-managed node resource group; SRE Agent, managed identities and separate monitoring in the Agent resource group. The Load Balancer connects to the node subnet. Arrows show image pulls, workload telemetry, alert investigation and infrastructure queries.
svg.text: Azure SRE Agent | AKS 데모 인프라
